post.title: Advanced Graph Algorithms: Dijkstra, Topological Sort, and Disjoint Set Union (DSU)
post.subtitle: Master shortest paths, dependency resolution, and cycle detection with robust Java solutions.
post.brief: Graph algorithms are the backbone of networking, scheduling, and connection analysis. This guide explores Dijkstra's pathfinding, Topological Sorting for dependency resolution, and Disjoint Set Union (DSU) for cycle detection, complete with runnable Java code.
